recorded.prompt:q-window:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-window:a: $T_i \subseteq Y$, the start years of project $i$: its window from the export, cut so that $t + d_i - 1 \le \max Y$
recorded.prompt:q-window:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-window:b: first = max(project.earliest_start, self.years[0]); last = min(project.latest_start, self.years[-1] - project.duration + 1); return range(first, last + 1)
recorded.prompt:q-window:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-window:c: A window that the cut empties is an empty range, so the project gets no variable and cannot be funded. (the cut gives last = 2030, so the range is not empty)
recorded.prompt:q-envelope:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.prompt:q-envelope:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-envelope:c: `steps/01` has one number for money and no years. ... from the cost profiles the export has always carried
recorded.prompt:q-envelope:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-envelope:d: `Project` has `capex`, one number, so the code cannot know that P022's $2,550k is spent as 360, 720 and 1,470 over three years. The model then has no variable that says *when*.
recorded.prompt:q-late:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-late:b: Note what the objective does not say: $v_i$ is the same for every start year, so the model has no reason to prefer an early start. That gap is left on purpose for the lesson *Value: NPV by start year and risk reduction*, where finance's NPV by start year fills it.
recorded.prompt:q-late:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-late:c: But the objective values a late start the same as an early one, so the solver is free to push a start late for no reason at all.
recorded.prompt:q-late:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-late:d: $v_i$ is the same for every start year, so the model has no reason to prefer an early start.
